text:
Hello, I am actually speaking to a customer service executive right now, isn't it? 

Anyway, let me explain the full situation. I checked the app, and my delivery address is completely correct—I live in building D of my apartment complex. However, the courier person has left my package, which is a silk saree worth Rs 5,999, in building B by mistake. 

Since it is a high-value item, I am quite concerned. Kindly do the needful and escalate this matter so that someone can arrange for the recovery from building B and get it re-delivered to my correct address in building D at the earliest. Please do the needful.
